sentences.cn_text: 大约2000年前,当罗马人开始撤离苏格兰时,他们留下了一件奇特的宝藏:10吨钉子,近百万枚之多。
sentences.en_text: Nearly 2,000 years ago, as the Romans began to pull out of Scotland, they left behind a curious treasure: 10 tons of nails, nearly a million of the things.

sentences.cn_text: 这批钉子藏品于1960年被发现,位于一个四米深的坑中,上面覆盖着两米厚的砾石。
sentences.en_text: The nail hoard was discovered in 1960 in a four-metre-deep pit covered by two metres of gravel.

sentences.cn_text: 罗马人为何要埋藏百万枚钉子?
sentences.en_text: Why had the Romans buried a million nails?

sentences.cn_text: 最可能的解释是撤退过于仓促,他们不想让当地喀里多尼亚人获得10吨武器级铁材。
sentences.en_text: The likely explanation is that the withdrawal was rushed, and they didn’t want the local Caledonians getting their hands on 10 tons of weapon-grade iron.

sentences.cn_text: 罗马人将钉子埋得极深,以至于近两千年都未被发现。
sentences.en_text: The Romans buried the nails so deep that they would not be discovered for almost two millennia.

sentences.cn_text: 后世文明对一枚钉子中熟练铁匠劳动的重视,甚至超过了对原材料本身的重视。
sentences.en_text: Later civilisations would value the skilled blacksmith’s labour in a nail even more than the raw material.

sentences.cn_text: 正如罗玛·阿格拉瓦尔在其新作《螺母与螺栓》中所解释的,17世纪早期的弗吉尼亚人在计划搬迁时有时会烧毁自己的房屋。
sentences.en_text: As Roma Agrawal explains in her new delightful book Nuts and Bolts, early 17th-century Virginians would sometimes burn down their homes if they were planning to relocate.

sentences.cn_text: 这是为了回收有价值的钉子,这些钉子在筛过灰烬后可以重新使用。
sentences.en_text: This was an attempt to recover the valuable nails, which could be reused after sifting the ashes.

sentences.cn_text: 仅为回收钉子而烧毁整座房屋的做法,凸显了这种看似简单的技术是多么稀缺、昂贵且珍贵。
sentences.en_text: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.

sentences.cn_text: 正如经济学家丹尼尔·西切尔在一篇研究论文中指出的,从18世纪末到20世纪中期,钉子的价格下降了90%。
sentences.en_text: The price of nails fell by 90% between the late 1700s and mid-1900s, as economist Daniel Sichel points out in a research paper.

sentences.cn_text: 根据西切尔的研究,虽然钉子价格的下降部分源于铁材和能源成本的降低,但主要归功于钉子制造商找到了更高效的方式将钢材制成钉子。
sentences.en_text: According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.

sentences.cn_text: 钉子本身多年来有所变化,但西切尔研究它们正是因为它们变化不大。
sentences.en_text: Nails themselves have changed over the years, but Sichel studied them because they haven’t changed much.

sentences.cn_text: 罗马灯与LED灯条、罗马战车与跑车大相径庭,但罗马钉与现代钉显然仍是同一种东西。
sentences.en_text: Roman lamps and Roman chariots are very different from LED strips and sports cars, but Roman nails are still clearly nails.

sentences.cn_text: 试图追踪自1695年以来跑车价格的变化是荒谬的,但对钉子提出同样的问题却完全合理。
sentences.en_text: It would be absurd to try to track the changing price of sports cars since 1695, but to ask the same question of nails makes perfect sense.

sentences.cn_text: 我对这些物品的某一特定特征——它们的价格——十分着迷,对此我毫不抱歉。
sentences.en_text: I make no apology for being obsessed by a particular feature of these objects: their price.

sentences.cn_text: 毕竟,我是经济学家。
sentences.en_text: I am an economist, after all.

sentences.cn_text: 在撰写两本关于发明史的著作后,我明白了一件事:尽管那些极为精密的技术吸引了所有关注,但真正改变世界的是廉价技术。
sentences.en_text: After writing two books about the history of inventions, one thing I’ve learnt is that while it is the enchantingly sophisticated technologies that get all the hype, it’s the cheap technologies that change the world.

sentences.cn_text: 古腾堡印刷机改变文明,并非通过改变书写的性质,而是通过改变其成本——而且若非一种常被忽视的技术即纸张令书写表面的价格同步下降,它也难有大的成就。
sentences.en_text: The Gutenberg printing press transformed civilisation not by changing the nature of writing but by changing its cost — and it would have achieved little without a parallel collapse in the price of surfaces to write on, thanks to an often-overlooked technology called paper.

sentences.cn_text: 太阳能板在价格变得低廉之前用途有限;如今它们正在改变全球能源体系。
sentences.en_text: Solar panels had few niche uses until they became cheap; now they are transforming the global energy system.

sentences.cn_text: 罗马人埋藏钉子可能是为了____。
sentences.en_text: The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ____

sentences.cn_text: 保存它们以供将来使用
sentences.en_text: saving them for future use.

sentences.cn_text: 防止它们生锈
sentences.en_text: keeping them from rusting.

sentences.cn_text: 让它们增值
sentences.en_text: letting them grow in value.

sentences.cn_text: 不让当地人获得它们
sentences.en_text: hiding them from the locals.

sentences.cn_text: 17世纪早期弗吉尼亚人的例子被用来____。
sentences.en_text: The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ____

sentences.cn_text: 突显早期美国殖民者的节俭作风
sentences.en_text: highlight the thriftiness of early American colonists.

sentences.cn_text: 说明那个时期铁匠的高地位
sentences.en_text: illustrate the high status of blacksmiths in that period.

sentences.cn_text: 对比不同文明对钉子的态度
sentences.en_text: contrast the attitudes of different civilisations towards nails.

sentences.cn_text: 展示当时钉子制造技术的珍贵性
sentences.en_text: show the preciousness of nail-making technology at that time.

sentences.cn_text: 18世纪末之后,什么在降低钉子价格方面起了主要作用?
sentences.en_text: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?

sentences.cn_text: 生产效率的提高
sentences.en_text: Increased productivity.

sentences.cn_text: 新能源的广泛使用
sentences.en_text: Wider use of new energies.

sentences.cn_text: 更激烈的市场竞争
sentences.en_text: Fiercer market competition.

sentences.cn_text: 原材料成本的降低
sentences.en_text: Reduced cost of raw materials.

sentences.cn_text: 从第5段可以了解到,钉子____。
sentences.en_text: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ____

sentences.cn_text: 经历了许多技术改进
sentences.en_text: have undergone many technological improvements.

sentences.cn_text: 自罗马时代以来基本保持不变
sentences.en_text: have remained basically the same since Roman times.

sentences.cn_text: 比其他日常产品受到的研究更少
sentences.en_text: are less studied than other everyday products.

sentences.cn_text: 是世界上最重要的发明之一
sentences.en_text: are one of the world’s most significant inventions.

sentences.cn_text: 以下哪项最能概括最后两段?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs?

sentences.cn_text: 廉价技术带来革命性变革
sentences.en_text: Cheap technologies bring about revolutionary change.

sentences.cn_text: 技术创新是经济成功的关键组成部分
sentences.en_text: Technological innovation is integral to economic success.

sentences.cn_text: 技术定义了人们对世界的理解
sentences.en_text: Technology defines people’s understanding of the world.

sentences.cn_text: 复杂技术源于小型发明
sentences.en_text: Sophisticated technologies develop from small inventions.
